name: Little ☆ Twins ~Sugu ni Toriko ni Shiteageru♪~
original_name: りとる☆ついんず ～すぐにトリコにしてあげる♪～
source:
"We're going to be your wife!"

I wonder how many years have passed since that day they said those words to me. Yuna, quiet and shy. Yuna, cheerful and always smiling. They are twin girls who came to call me “Papa” and adore me after a brief exchange when they were children.

One summer day, I was asked to take care of them for a while. The twins' mother, who is a cousin to me, had to go abroad on a business trip.
I had not seen them for two years because I was busy with work.

 The two of them had become very cute and were very vulnerable, perhaps because they were at ease. I was left in a state of shock, that I've fallen to such a childish "curse", I played along with their slightly naughty feelings.

"Papa, you need to release a lot of white pee, you never know what kind of negative effects you might have if you resist the curse!"

[From [url=https://www.ammolite-game.com/amml_012/amml_012_chara.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
“我们要成为你的妻子！”

我不知道距离她们说出那句话，已经过去多少年了。安静害羞的优奈，以及开朗爱笑的优奈。她们是一对双胞胎女孩，小时候与我短暂相处后便开始叫我“爸爸”，并一直仰慕着我。

某个夏日，我受托暂时照顾她们。她们的母亲——我的表亲——因工作出差去了国外。由于忙于工作，我已经两年没见过她们了。

两人都出落得十分可爱，或许是因为在我面前放松下来，也变得格外脆弱。我震惊地发现，自己已经陷入这种幼稚的“诅咒”，于是顺着她们略带淘气的感情发展。

“爸爸，你得排出很多白色的尿，不然一直忍着的话，谁知道会因为诅咒产生什么不良影响呢！”
